renderer_matrix.oracle: Installed native token/renderer spans plus the explicitly recorded existing conservative reference-protection policy; every literal-hit membership also agrees with native renderer without policy overlay. Not pure DOM/AST interval parity.

baseline_red.scope: 238 frozen renderer/policy cases against immutable pre-change implementation; baseline hash asserted by pytest plugin.

discarded_initial_oracle_stage.scope: Early oracle omitted native token ownership in image alt and had JS CRLF-anchor/HTML-overlap differences; not used as authoritative product-failure count.

pre_whitespace_checkpoint.scope: Earlier normal-exit API run before removal of one surplus blank line at test file EOF; XML retained separately. Not the current final source-hash run.

green.scope: 238 frozen cases, eight explicit source-read work counters, sixteen API behavior cases.

api_regression.scope: Same 26 cleanup-related API modules as parent checkpoint, one normal-exit run; not the complete API suite.

work_counter_scope.bound: At most 80 times input length for explicit measured source indexing/slicing/find-prefix reads; excludes regex internals, total bucket work, RSS and all-input complexity.

timing_scope: 37 alternating-order paired local component controls, three samples per version; medians/ranges and range equality are recorded in raw artifact. Reference no-URL controls show recognition cost; not an all-input latency or complexity guarantee.
validation_limits: Multiline definition label/destination/title plus email and www retained probes still differ; complete inline parser parity is not claimed.
Older HTML physical-line/container/newline conservative extras remain; exact parity on new corpus does not remove them.
Reference-heavy and unmatched-reference controls have measurable cost; operation-local structures and timing are not universal complexity, RSS, OOM, throughput, or production-latency guarantees.
Installed server renderer is not application adapters/sanitizer, browser DOM, authenticated Reader, PostgreSQL concurrency, CI, or production acceptance.
No web search, Web build/browser, complete API suite, CI dispatch/result fetch or production verification.
No commit/push/deploy, dependency/migration/offline-format/imported-user-data/production-config changes. Active goal remains in progress.
